items.title: 8.6 Characteristics of chemical equilibrium (chemical equilibrium ki khaas baatein) (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 8.6, printed page 172.

blocks.text: Equilibrium ki important features (khaas baatein) yeh hain:

items: Chemical equilibrium par reactants aur products ki concentrations constant rehti hain.
Reversible reaction mein equilibrium tak dono taraf se pohancha ja sakta hai, chahe hum reactants se shuru karein ya products se.
Catalyst equilibrium ki position aur equilibrium constant nahi badalta. Yeh sirf equilibrium jaldi lane mein madad karta hai.
Equilibrium constant ki value reactants ki shuru ki concentrations par depend nahi karti; yeh constant hai aur sirf temperature par depend karti hai.

blocks.title: Keep in Mind! (yaad rakhein!)
blocks.text: Agar equilibrium mein pure (khalis) solids ya pure liquids shamil hon to un ki concentrations equilibrium constant ke expression mein nahi likhi jatin, kyun ke pure solid ya liquid ki concentration badalne se equilibrium constant par koi asar nahi parta.

blocks.title: Asaan alfaaz mein
blocks.text: Example: CaCO₃(s) ⇌ CaO(s) + CO₂(g) mein dono solids expression se bahar hain, is liye Kc = [CO₂]. Kisi temperature par CO₂ ki concentration fixed (tay shuda) hoti hai, chahe CaCO₃ thora ho ya zyada.

items: Equilibrium par concentrations constant; dono taraf se pohancha ja sakta hai.
Catalyst sirf equilibrium jaldi lata hai; position aur constant nahi badalta.
Equilibrium constant sirf temperature par depend karta hai; pure solids aur liquids expression mein nahi aate.
